intro: These supply sacks belong to a caravan shipment intended for the goblin engineer Rezlak outside Orgrimmar. Transported across Durotar, the goods were intercepted by the Dustwind harpies roosting in the crags of Razorwind Canyon.

p: Rezlak, an engineer contracted out of Ratchet by Gazlowe, relies on regular caravans through Durotar to supply his construction efforts for the Horde. Durotar's wilderness, however, is far from tame. When a promised shipment passed near the canyon road south of Orgrimmar, it was ambushed and pillaged by the local Dustwind harpies. The vicious creatures hauled the cargo deep into their roosts within Razorwind Canyon, scattering the sacks among the dirt and scree alongside harpy nesting sites.
